Snapjaw.description: A short-faced bank burrower with a broad back of overlapping shale plates. Its grasping foreclaws rake loose earth into low walls around the burrow mouth.

SnapjawScavenger.description: Discarded cutting tools sit between this marlback’s shale back plates. It works the river wrack with a blunt snout and quick grasping claws, retreating toward its burrow when pressed.

SnapjawHunter.description: This short-faced marlback braces a salvaged pole across the passage. Pale shale plates overlap its broad back; hooked digging claws grip the wet bank beneath it.

SnapjawChieftain.description: Layers of dark shale broaden this marlback’s back above a patched digging harness. It keeps a long cutting tool ready beside the low wall of its burrow.

SnapjawWarlord.description: Heavy shale plates crowd the shoulders of this blunt-faced marlback. It carries a wedge-cleaver made for splitting roots and swings its weight forward with each stubborn step.

SnapjawCorpse.description: Overlapping shale plates lie slack above short limbs and broad digging claws. Mud still fills the seams of the bank burrower’s back.

GlowMoth.description: A hand-sized moth with broad translucent wings, each crossed by three soft bars of pale grove-light. It navigates by the columns; the glow is dust on its wings.

WarlordCleaver.description: A salvaged wedge-blade lashed to a short haft. Shale grit fills its binding; the broad edge is worn from splitting roots and breaking packed banks.

SootGremlin.description: A small soot-dark creature with blunt claws and a nose dusted grey from old hearths. It paws through anything left near the cold ash.

DirtGnome.description: A squat earth-grubber with soil worked into the creases of its skin. Its broad claws have loosened more roots than the farmer cares to count.
